property.name: subtitle
property.value: Carpets, pendulums and spirits in the night air

property.name: text
property.value: Night wind makes every jump drift. Face the gust and use the carpet only after it begins moving.

property.name: text
property.value: A carpet plus a crosswind is the first lock. Stay aboard until the lantern platform.

property.name: text
text
property.value: Ghul spirits freeze when faced. Turn toward one, pass it, then use the wind to escape the next room.

property.name: text
property.value: Final wind chamber: jump, slash, and steer into the sheltered exit.
